2607.15275.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
2607.15275.paper_summary: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. At this context length, we unlock new robot capabilities: one-shot in-context imitation from human video demonstrations, on-the-fly policy improvement, robustness to perturbations, and stronger performance on multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. We also observe, for the first time, steady gains in closed-loop performance as pretraining context length scales. At its core, RoboTTT integrates Test-Time Training into robot foundation models such as Vision-Language-Action policies, yielding a sequence model whose recurrent state consists of fast weights, parameters updated by gradient descent during both training and inference, compressing histories into weight space and retrieving contextual information for long-context conditioning. To scale training context length, the recipe combines sequence action forcing with truncated backpropagation through time. On challenging real-robot manipulation tasks, RoboTTT improves overall performance by 87% over the single-step context baseline and fully completes a five-minute, ten-stage assembly task, which no baseline ever does. RoboTTT trained with 8K-timestep context outperforms the same model pretrained with 1K timesteps by 62%, suggesting context length as a new scaling axis for robot foundation models. Videos are available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/
2607.15275.paper_summary_zh: 最近的機器人基礎模型在單步或短期視覺運動上下文中運作。<lb/>我們介紹了測試時訓練機器人政策（RoboTTT），這是一種機器人模型和訓練配方，將視覺運動上下文擴展到8K時間步，超越了最先進政策的三個數量級，且不增加推理延遲。<lb/>在這個上下文長度下，我們解鎖了新的機器人能力：從人類視頻演示中進行一次性上下文模仿、即時政策改進、對擾動的穩健性，以及在多階段、長期任務上的更強性能。<lb/>我們還首次觀察到，隨著預訓練上下文長度的擴展，閉環性能穩定增長。<lb/>RoboTTT的核心將測試時訓練整合到機器人基礎模型中，例如視覺-語言-行動政策，產生一個序列模型，其循環狀態由快速權重組成，這些參數在訓練和推理過程中通過梯度下降進行更新，將歷史壓縮到權重空間並檢索上下文信息以進行長上下文條件。<lb/>為了擴展訓練上下文長度，該配方結合了序列動作強制和截斷時間反向傳播。<lb/>在具有挑戰性的真實機器人操作任務中，RoboTTT的整體性能比單步上下文基線提高了87%，並且完整完成了一個五分鐘、十階段的組裝任務，這是任何基線都無法做到的。<lb/>使用8K時間步上下文訓練的RoboTTT比使用1K時間步預訓練的相同模型提高了62%，這表明上下文長度是機器人基礎模型的一個新的擴展軸。<lb/>視頻可在 https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/ 獲得。
